headline: This law clarifies which office sets the paperwork rules for legislative branch employees who take disabled veteran leave.
what_it_does: Federal employees can take disabled veteran leave for medical treatment of a service-connected disability. They must certify that the leave was used for that purpose, and the Office of Personnel Management sets the form and process for that certification. This law adds a rule saying which office sets the certification form and process for employees in the legislative branch.

who_it_affects.group: Legislative branch employees who use disabled veteran leave
who_it_affects.how: They will follow the certification form and process set by the office named in the law, rather than an unclear source of authority.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who use disabled veteran leave
who_it_affects.how: The summary describes no change to the certification rules that apply to them under the Office of Personnel Management.
